summary: Self-learning axis sweep done; position still UNOCCUPIED as a product. Field splits cleanly: products (Devin Knowledge, Windsurf/Augment memories, Hermes) couple learning to real work but judging is human-or-self only with no rival attempts; research/optimizers (DGM, AlphaEvolve/OpenEvolve/ShinkaEvolve, SICA, GEPA) have external metrics + rival populations but run offline with no work coupling or cross-task transfer — nobody holds all five axes. Closest to our loop conceptually is DGM/OpenEvolve; closest as a product is Devin Knowledge (human accept/dismiss validation only). Cursor REMOVING its Memories feature (2.1.x) is market proof that unjudged learning fails — the judge is the moat. Fastest productizer threats: Cognition (just add metric validation to Knowledge), then a startup wrapping OpenEvolve/GEPA (optimizer is pip+MCP-ready; missing the metric-UX and work-graph layer we built). Positioning: claim the productized work-graph-coupled honest-benchmark instantiation, never conceptual novelty over DGM/AlphaEvolve. Codename collision FLAGGED: rename "Darwin" before public launch (Darwin Gödel Machine owns the term in this category; getdarwin.ai is a funded "self-learning AI employee"). item.value: Self-learning landscape splits into two camps, each holding 3 of our 5 axes: products (Devin Knowledge, Windsurf/Augment memories, Hermes) have real-work coupling + persistence + transfer but NO external judging and NO rival attempts; research/optimizers (DGM, AlphaEvolve/OpenEvolve, SICA, GEPA) have external metrics + rivals but NO production coupling and NO cross-task transfer. Nobody holds all five — our position remains unoccupied as a product (verified 2026-06-10).

Devin Knowledge (closest product to our loop): auto-suggests learnings from real sessions + auto-generates Repo Knowledge (2026), but validation is purely human accept/edit/dismiss — no execution test, no metric, no regression check before reuse. Cognition is the fastest-path productizer threat: they'd only need to bolt metric validation onto an existing knowledge store + Windsurf distribution. docs.devin.ai/product-guides/knowledge

Cursor REMOVED its Memories feature in 2.1.x (told users to convert to static Rules) — direct market evidence that unjudged automatic memory accretion fails in production. The judging loop, not the storage, is the differentiator. Cursor 3 cloud agents only get an unvalidated free-form notepad (MEMORIES.md).

Codename collision FLAG: 'Darwin' is now dominantly associated with Sakana's Darwin Gödel Machine (arXiv:2505.22954, SWE-bench 20→50%) — the most famous work in our exact claimed category — plus getdarwin.ai ($11.2M 'self-learning AI employee'), Cognation/darwin, and a16z-speedrun Darwin. Fine internally; rename before public launch — invites the 'just DGM' dismissal we must avoid. DGM itself: metric-judged + rival archive, but offline/benchmark-only (~$22k/run), no work coupling; now under Sakana's RSI Lab (research, not product).

Positioning rule for the learning axis: do NOT claim conceptual novelty over DGM/AlphaEvolve/SICA/GEPA (published, ICLR-oral territory). DO claim the productized instantiation: honest researched benchmarks + user metrics on real tasks, learning during real work in worktrees (not $22k offline runs), learnings persisting in a work graph with context-edge transfer, and converge/stuck/escalate human control. Line: 'DGM/AlphaEvolve proved the loop works on benchmarks; Darwin runs that loop on your backlog.'

Near-term productizer threats beyond Cognition: (1) startup wrapping OpenEvolve/GEPA — OpenEvolve is pip-installable and already MCP-wrapped (AMD ROCm HPC agent); ShinkaEvolve (ICLR 2026) added subscription-backed CLI mutation models May 2026, slashing cost barriers; missing piece is metric-definition UX + repo/work-graph integration (6-12mo). (2) GEPA (DSPy, ICLR 2026 oral) is the strongest metric-judged rival-attempt machinery devs use today, but offline, pipeline-scoped. (3) Long-horizon: frontier-lab self-play (SWE-RL, Multi-Agent Evolve) bakes the loop into weights — commoditizes the layer eventually, not a near-term product.

Classify each by WHAT it learns and whether learning is metric-judged and execution-coupled. Compare against our optimize loop.
